name: pm
description: PM helpers for team Linear workflows. Skills for request intake (an incoming request or an idea of your own, scored for gaps, then shaped into a Linear project and routed to ticketing), a PM-mode planning session (read the real state, slice work into cold-handoff tickets, confirm every write), single-ticket authoring (a short shaping interview, body composed to the shared issue-body spec), the weekly grooming loop (per-person WIP), plan-to-tickets breakdown (assignee-aware), chart-first mapping of efforts too large to plan in one session, questionnaires that pull a blocking decision out of someone else's head, and end-of-cycle retro notes (attribution + Linear-first output). Ships the linear-ops agent and the Linear MCP gotchas reference; composes with the user-level linear skill when installed; ndr and librarian integrations are optional externals.
